title: Transepithelial Versus Conventional PRK: A Randomized Controlled Study

license.statement: CC BY-NC 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International License)

indication: myopia (eligibility allowed myopia or hyperopia; Results: all enrolled subjects were myopic); prospective randomized contralateral masked single-surgeon noninferiority trial (NCT04698174), TENEO 317 Model 2 excimer laser, mitomycin C 0.02% in both arms

groups.description: conventional alcohol-assisted PRK (20% alcohol 30 s, epithelium removed with a microhoe), then excimer ablation, mitomycin C 0.02% 30 s, protective contact lens; one eye of each of 35 subjects (far-dominant eye randomized to either procedure); declared control eyes

transepithelial PRK (laser epithelial removal, default 54 um) with the same laser, mitomycin C and contact lens; fellow eye of the same 35 subjects; further 1:1 randomization to end-treatment laser polishing (5 um) or not, pooled in Table 2; declared study eyes of the noninferiority comparison

series.baseline_label: Baseline manifest spherical equivalent (Table 2, Conventional PRK)
series.notes: mean (SD); baseline cell also prints a range (not used); three subjects lost to follow-up (two after 1 month, one after 3 months), per-visit n not tabulated
mean (SD); with and without end-treatment polishing pooled; baseline cell also prints a range (not used); same attrition as the fellow eyes

notes: Refraction: manifest subjective refraction by phoropter or trial frame in 0.25 D steps with a mandatory cross cylinder (Methods); recorded as manifest.
Target refraction not stated (standard manufacturer nomograms); recorded as unstated.
Contralateral design: the two groups are fellow eyes of the same subjects, treated by the study as separate groups.
Methods visits: 1 day, 4 days, 1 week, 1 month, 3 months and 6 months; Table 2 tabulates baseline, 1 week, 3 months and 6 months only.
Table 2 footnote: during analysis one subject's manifest refraction sign was corrected after a discrepancy with cycloplegic refraction (as published).
Negative Tab2 SE cells print a unicode minus, then a space, then the number; cell text not edited.
UDVA/CDVA, contrast sensitivity, halos and glare, pain, satisfaction (Tab3), haze and manifest sphere/cylinder are reported; not extracted.
